absence.message: Hiking in the Dolomites with patchy signal. For anything launch-related, ask Jonas.

conversations.name: Spring launch
conversations.description: Everything for the April release: copy, builds, press, and the party.

scheduled.text: 🚀 **We're live!** Thank you all — this one was a team effort. Party details below 👇

messages.text:
**Launch plan** 📌

1. Tuesday 9:00 — blog post and App Store release
2. 9:15 — newsletter
3. 10:00 — social posts
4. Friday — launch party 🎉
Perfect, that's the order the press list expects too.
Press kit is **done** 🎉 Fact sheet, screenshots and the logo pack:
Amazing. I'll send it to the three outlets tomorrow morning.
Thank you both — great work on this 🙌

Morning! RC3 is up on TestFlight. Changelog:

- Faster launch from the local cache
- Reactions show *who* reacted
- Fixed the unread badge getting stuck
Signed in on a fresh Mac — all good ✅
Accessibility pass done. VoiceOver reads every message row correctly.
Crash-free sessions at 99.8% 🎯
Let's call it. RC3 is the release build 🚢

messages.caption: Final hero artwork for the launch page. Last chance for comments!

messages.text: That gradient is *so* good.
Are we still locked for **Tuesday 9:00** for the launch post?
Yes — Tuesday 9:00 it is. @sofia can you schedule the newsletter for 9:15?
messages.edit: Yes — Tuesday 9:00 it is. @sofia could you schedule the newsletter for 9:15?

messages.text: On it 📬 Draft is here: https://nextcloud.com/talk/
Ramen it is then 🍜 I'll book a table for eight.
Perfect. See you all there!
Do you have the latest numbers for the beta sign-ups?
2,340 as of this morning — up 18% on last week 📈
That's brilliant. Let's put it in the launch post.

messages.voice: Hey Freja! Quick one. The newsletter is scheduled for Tuesday at nine fifteen, and I added the beta numbers to the intro. Let me know if you want to change anything before then.

messages.text: Want to grab a coffee before the all-hands? ☕️

conversations.name: Watercooler
conversations.description: Photos, cake alerts, and everything that isn't work.

messages.caption: The new espresso machine has landed ☕️

messages.text: Best news all week.
Finally! The old one sounded like a jet engine 😄

messages.caption: Greetings from the Dolomites 🏔️ Signal is terrible, views are not.

messages.text: Wow 😍
That water can't be real.
Theo, are you taking questions about the retry logic from there? 😇
Absolutely not 🙃

messages.caption: 🎂 Cake in the kitchen — happy birthday @elena!

messages.text: Happy birthday Elena! 🎉
Happy birthday!! 🥳
You're all very sweet. Especially the cake. 🍰

conversations.name: Design crit
conversations.description: Share work in progress. Be kind, be specific.

messages.text: Weekly crit is at 15:00 — drop anything you want eyes on in here first.

messages.caption: Onboarding, take two. Fewer steps, bigger type.

messages.text: Much calmer than v1. Could the second screen lose the illustration?

messages.caption: New sidebar spacing is in the component library — tighter rows, same click targets.

messages.text: Looks great on the 13" too.
@freja could you take a look at the empty states before 3? 🙏
Jumping on a quick call to go through them now — come join!

conversations.name: Announcements
conversations.description: Company news. Only moderators can post here.

messages.text: **Autumn offsite** 🍂 is confirmed for 14–15 October in Aarhus. Travel and hotel are booked for everyone — details in your inbox.
@all Welcome **Priya Raman** to the team! 👋 Priya joins as Head of Customer Success. Say hi in #Watercooler.
The journalist from the tech podcast wants a 20-minute call next week.
Happy to! Wednesday afternoon works best for me.
Booked for Wednesday 14:00 👍
Thanks for walking me through the press list — that helped a lot.
Any time 🙂

scheduled.text: Reminder: release retro at 10:00 today. Bring one thing that went well and one we should change.

messages.text: Heads up: the build machine gets its update tonight, so expect CI to be slow for an hour.
Found the scrolling hitch. We were re-measuring every row on each new message:
Ha, nice catch! That explains the stutter on long threads.

> only the row that changed

This is also why typing felt slow in big groups. Two birds, one stone.
RC3 is signed and uploaded. Crash-free sessions at **99.8%** 🎯
Ship it! 🚢
I'm off from tomorrow — Jonas has the keys to the release pipeline 🔑
Have a wonderful trip! Don't check Talk 😄
No promises 😅
Who's in for Friday lunch? 🥢
Me!
Count me in

messages.caption: This is the one I keep telling you about.

messages.text: Sold. See you there at 12 😋
Love the warm tones. Let's go with this direction.

**Launch week**

- Book the ramen place
- Podcast prep: three stories about the beta
- Thank-you notes to the beta testers
Wi-Fi at the Aarhus hotel: `offsite-2026` 🔑

conversations.name: Beta feedback
conversations.description: Open to anyone with the link. Tell us what you think!

messages.text: Welcome to the beta feedback room! 👋 Anything goes: bugs, ideas, praise.
Keyboard navigation in the sidebar is *chef's kiss* ⌨️
Thank you! ⌘K is my favourite too.
Next month: *The Left Hand of Darkness*. Discussion on the 28th.
Finally! I've wanted to read it for years.
